notes.title: Anime Girls DLC now avaliable.
notes.content:
Exciting News! Monkey Party - Anime Girls DLC Released Today!

Hey Monkey Party fans!

We’re thrilled to announce that the highly-anticipated Monkey Party - Anime Girls DLC is officially released today! 🎉 Get ready to experience your favorite mischievous monkeys transformed into adorable and captivating anime girls. This DLC brings a delightful anime twist to the game with enhanced visuals, unique character animations, and loads of new customizations.

What's Included:

Anime Girl Transformations: See your monkeys take on charming anime personas, each with unique outfits and animations.

You can check it out here :

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3076360/Monkey_Party__Anime_Girls/

But that's not all! We're also excited to announce that Monkey Party will be FREE for everyone in about a month! 🎁 This is the perfect time to jump into the fun and see what all the excitement is about.

Thank you for your incredible support. We can’t wait to see how you enjoy the new Anime Girls DLC. Join the party and let the anime antics begin!

Happy gaming!

The Monkey Party Team

notes.title: Quick Fix to High Score
notes.content: High score was previously displaying the incorrect data, this has been fixed!

notes.title: Bug Fixes and Game Over Screen!
notes.content: Introducing a brand new Game Over screen and a dynamic game over sound effect to enhance your Monkey Party experience! We've also been hard at work addressing various bugs based on your invaluable feedback. Your input matters to us, and we're committed to making Monkey Party the best it can be! Now, the Game Over screen displays your score for that round, your high score, and even the current world record, so you can track your progress like never before!
